name: Element Lifestyle Retirement Inc.
summary: Element Lifestyle Retirement Inc. develops and operates senior retirement communities in British Columbia, Canada. The company provides development consulting services, such as property selection, assembly and acquisition, building and community design, municipal approval and land entitlement processes, financing, marketing, sales and leasing, and construction project management. It also offers long-term management services for the facilities, which include management of the administration, operation, and financing of retirement communities and physical facilities. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
